english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a pleasant or unpleasant smell.

examples.english: This soup has a lovely smell.
examples.traditional: 呢碗湯有陣好香嘅味道。
examples.jyutping: ni1 wun2 tong1 jau5 zan6 hou2 hoeng1 ge3 mei6 dou6

english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the flavor or taste of something.

examples.english: The taste of this soup is very strong.
examples.jyutping: nei1 wun2 tong1 ge3 mei6 dou6 hou2 nung4
